title: ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md committed as a raw unfilled template, violating its own embedded guide ('delete these comments; never emit a comment in the finished spine')
evidence:
+name: '{name}'
+type: architecture-spine
...
+# Architecture Spine — {name}
+
+<!-- TEMPLATE GUIDE — act on these comments, then delete them; never emit a comment in the finished spine.
detail: Every field is a {placeholder}; the guide comments the template itself forbids are retained. The sibling memlog records the run CLOSED/withdrawn — this is dead scaffolding committed as canon.
recommended_fix: Delete the file or replace it with the actual (withdrawn) decision record; never commit the template with placeholders and guide comments.

detail: Every path assigns cur before it is read; the raw initializer is dead and misleadingly suggests a raw-fallback route that cannot execute.
